summary: Larry Ellison, the billionaire cofounder of Oracle, told investors that AI will enable a vast surveillance system where citizens will be 'on their best behavior' due to constant monitoring. He envisions AI analyzing feeds from security cameras, police body cameras, and drones, with AI drones replacing police cars in high-speed chases.

claims.text: Larry Ellison said AI will be used to constantly watch and analyze vast surveillance systems, including security cameras, police body cameras, doorbell cameras, and vehicle dashboard cameras.
claims.evidence_quote: Ellison said AI would be used in the future to constantly watch and analyze vast surveillance systems, like security cameras, police body cameras, doorbell cameras, and vehicle dashboard cameras.

claims.text: Ellison stated that 'citizens will be on their best behavior' because everything is constantly recorded and reported.
claims.evidence_quote: Citizens will be on their best behavior because we are constantly recording and reporting everything that's going on.

claims.text: Ellison expects AI drones to replace police cars in high-speed chases.
claims.evidence_quote: Ellison also expects AI drones to replace police cars in high-speed chases.

claims.text: Ellison said every police officer will be supervised at all times by AI, which will report problems to the appropriate person.
claims.evidence_quote: Every police officer is going to be supervised at all times, and if there's a problem, AI will report that problem and report it to the appropriate person.

claims.text: Oracle is pursuing AI opportunities, including a partnership with Elon Musk's SpaceX.
claims.evidence_quote: It already has several projects in the works, including one in partnership with Elon Musk's SpaceX.

claims.text: Larry Ellison is the world's sixth-richest man with a net worth of $157 billion, according to Bloomberg.
claims.evidence_quote: Ellison is the world's sixth-richest man with a net worth of $157 billion, according to Bloomberg.

claims.text: Ellison's daughter Megan Ellison founded Annapurna Pictures in 2011.

claims.text: Ellison's son David Ellison is set to become CEO of Paramount after its merger with Skydance Media.
